transcript.description: The student's answer exactly as received.

corrected.description: The whole answer rewritten in natural, correct English, same meaning.

score.description: Overall score 0-100 for the student's level.

fluency.description: Naturalness and flow of the sentences, 0-100.

task.description: How well the answer addresses the topic, 0-100.

mistakes.description: Most important mistakes, at most 8. Empty if none.

original.description: Exact fragment the student said, copied from the transcript.

correction.description: Single best corrected version of that fragment (one option).

type.description: Category of the mistake. 'pronunciation': a word that is not English, written the way it sounded, and the English word it most likely was (by sound and context) is the correction. 'unclear': words that match no plausible English at all; then 'correction' repeats 'original' exactly.

explanation.description: Short explanation in simple English (1-2 sentences) of why it is wrong.

strengths.description: What the student did well, in simple English, at most 5.

tip.description: One practical tip in simple English for the next answer.
